name: workflow-engine
notes: Business API is under /api/v1 (old unversioned paths answer as deprecated aliases); /health (liveness), /ready (readiness: own DB SELECT 1 within 1 s, 503 naming the failing check), /docs, /openapi.json stay at the root. Kotlin/Spring Boot 4.1, Java 25, Gradle. make dev stops any running engine on 47831, starts compose Postgres on 127.0.0.1:55434, runs bootRun and opens the console. DATABASE_URL is JDBC form. Swagger at /docs. Browser console at /. Auth is the X-User header; dev users and roles come from workflow.rbac.grants in application.yaml (stub until the central rbac service). Two sample workflows call the demo providers on localhost:47831 by hard-coded URL. Tests use Testcontainers (Docker required). The React workflow studio (apps/web, mock/demo/live profiles, no backend needed in mock and demo) runs on 5183 with `make web`; the static demo build for the fleet stack is `pnpm -C apps/web build:demo` (apps/web/dist, served on 15183). The engine does not yet serve the studio's /api/v1 contract (docs/ui-plan.md section 4). Input limits (SECURITY.md): Bean Validation on every route, unknown fields rejected, 1 MB body cap (413), JSON only (415), problem+json errors[] of paths. Rate limits per user else IP: reads RATE_LIMIT_READ_PER_MIN=300, writes RATE_LIMIT_WRITE_PER_MIN=60, heavy (start/restart/retry run, send event, fire timeout, demo reset) RATE_LIMIT_HEAVY_PER_MIN=20; RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=false only in tests. Security headers (SecurityHeadersFilter; HSTS only with TLS=true) and strict CORS from CORS_ORIGINS (comma-separated, default the studio origins http://localhost:5183 and :15183 plus 127.0.0.1; never *).
